headline: SWE-Flux reports a repository-level benchmark for dynamic code execution reasoning
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces SWE-Flux, a benchmark for predicting dynamic code behavior in real Python repositories. It contains 480 questions across 12 repositories, with answers harvested from instrumented test executions. In the authors’ five-model evaluation, GPT-5.4 scored 37.71% overall; dataflow questions were especially difficult. An input-perturbation pipeline generated valid variants for 52 of 58 selected instances, which were harder for the tested models. These are paper-reported results; the linked benchmark repository and evaluations were not independently inspected or reproduced, and coverage is limited to Python and the selected repositories.
